owner_instruction: "Let's get a better default map for now and we can develop further later." Given after being told that a calibrated default is blocked on evidence (failed prospective placement transfer, no dated size labels) and that the alternative is an explicitly development-fitted default.

what_changes.layer: Settlements (reach_towns) in the active Earth atlas, both climates.
what_changes.new_default: market6_50_capped: coupled cell people, work and cereal ledger (600 farm hours, 7.5% transfer) with market forwarding along same-actor links of at most 6 days each way all year, 50% passed up, every cohort-capable town keeping 150 residents.
what_changes.previous_default: joint365 (joint food budget, a year of origin stores). It stays selectable in the core view, labelled as the previous default.

what_does_not_change: Supply-supported reach keeps its default, control v2.1 (v21_joint365): it is the Earth blind-tested map and the new scenario has no comparable test.
Climate, harvest, population, administration and every other layer and packet. No existing data file is modified; the default is a selection among already published options.
All other experimental options and their status.
why_this_case: It is the only reviewed case that both keeps staffed sources (888 of 889 corrected, 865 against 861 raw) and reach (6.38 of 6.38 bins corrected) at the no-forwarding level and passes all six declared relative-size checks against the Roman references in both climates. It adds cell-level people, work and rural-meal accounting that the previous default lacks.
status_shown_to_readers: Scenario tier, with the text: development-fitted, not prospectively validated. It must not be labelled Earth-tested or partly tested.
known_limits_accepted_by_this_decision: This overrides the roadmap rule that defaults change only on qualified evidence, for this layer, by explicit owner decision. The rule stands for later changes.
The forwarding share, market range and cohort floor are declared scenario values, not fitted or validated. Relative sizes were compared with exposed Roman references in development only.
Built on the original coupled parents: staff collection hours, continuous destination inventories and worker calendars from the other line do not yet constrain it.
Placement is unchanged and its one prospective transfer test failed; absolute sizes, dated occupancy, complete diets and mobile or nonstate communities remain open.
If the optional market packet is missing or fails its checksum the atlas falls back to the previous default.
required_before_calling_it_done: Default switch with fallback, honest evidence text, previous default retained, browser checks of the default path and of the other optional families, before and after maps shown to the owner, Windows-style clone check, roadmap and handoff updated.
revisit: Replace or re-run when forwarding has been run on the dispatch-limited parents, or when qualified size or transfer evidence exists.
